property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer returns true iff every external transferFrom call to the callee succeeds; the mutant ignores callee failures and can return true even when a callee reverts, so there exists inputs (a failing callee) where the mutant returns true but the reference would revert/return false.
change_summary: Replace the internal call so it ignores the returned success flag and does not require _s, changing behavior when the callee fails.
